snippet.title: First Look at Touhou Kichouden ~ Mythos of Phantasmagoria 2
snippet.description:
Behold, the second part of the Chuhou Joutai origin story.

Kichou Kirisame and Miho Fujiwara are enigmatic characters first mentioned in the third Chuhou Joutai game and even cosplayed by that game’s two player characters. In the sequel to Mythos of Phantasmagoria, you can explore and uncover the truth of Crown Prince Kichou and the foundation he laid for the legacy of the Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo.

Get the game (open beta releasing on Friday, January 17):
https://drillimation.com/touhou-kichouden-mythos-of-phantasmagoria-2
